items.title: Cloudflare Tests Cache Transcoding to Reduce Storage Requirements
items.author: Renato Losio
items.excerpt: Cloudflare recently described a prototype called Cache Transcoding that compresses eligible cache content, mainly uncompressed text such as HTML, JSON, CSS, and JavaScript, using Zstandard before storing it on disk.

items.title: Waymo pulls over, calls cops on riders with a ghost gun
items.author: Terrence O’Brien
items.excerpt: Two people were arrested in San Fransico while riding around in a Waymo robotaxi after the cab pulled over and called the cops on them. The riders were juveniles in possession of a loaded AR-style ghost gun and were taken to a juvenile hall.

items.title: Attackers Use Passkey Phishing to Hijack Microsoft Cloud Accounts and Exfiltrate Data
items.author: info@thehackernews.com (The Hacker News)
